round_title: Round 2: ₹1,000 Ka Kaal-Chakra — Kitne Din Tak Karna Hai?
topic_focus: Duration, Number of Trades, Habit Formation, Dopamine Desensitization
dhan_grounded_evidence: Dhan Trader's Diary tracks daily streaks and tags. Over 60 trades (30 days x 2 trades), psychological discipline stabilizes.
ghanshyam_grounded_evidence: Ghanshyam Tech: 'Ek hi quantity se kam se kam 3 mahine ya 60 trades karne chahiye jab tak ki trade lene par dil ki dhadkan tez na ho.'
quant_evidence: Law of Large Numbers: A sample size of N >= 60 trades is mathematically required to establish statistical significance (p < 0.05) distinguishing skill from random market noise.

guru_arguments.Siddharth Bhanushali: Rajon poochh raha hai kitne din tak karna hai? Main bolta hoon strictly **30 Trading Days**! Iska matlab calendar ke lagbhag 6 hafte. Har hafte 5 din, total 60 trades. Agar tumne 10 din karke bola 'maine seekh liya', toh market agle hi din tumhe zameen par patak dega.
guru_arguments.Abhishek Kar: 30 din isliye zaroori hain kyunki in 30 dinon mein tum market ke har rang dekhoge — trending day, rangebound day, gap-up trap, gap-down panic. ₹1,000 par jab loss hoga ₹2 ka, toh tumhara dimaag gusse mein nahi aayega. Dopamine desensitize ho jayega.
guru_arguments.Pushkar Raj Thakur: Sahi baat hai. 30 trading days tak roz subah 9:15 se 10:30 AM tak baithna hai, 2 trades lene hain, aur journal mein note karna hai ki entry kyun li, SL kahan tha, aur exit kyun kiya.
guru_arguments.VP Financials: Yes, 30 days × 2 trades/day = 60 trades. This forms the foundational sample size to compute your actual win-rate and profit factor before touching real money.

consensus_verdict: Exactly 30 Trading Days (6 calendar weeks, 60 total trades). Zero exceptions. Not a single rupee of additional capital to be added during these 30 days.
graduation_gate: Completion of exactly 60 trades across 30 sessions with Dhan Trader's Diary completely tagged.
penalty_box_condition: Taking a 3rd trade on any single day resets the 30-day counter back to Day 1.

graduation_gate: Account grows from ₹10,000 to ₹20,000+ net of all charges.
penalty_box_condition: Any drop below ₹7,500 requires instant demotion to Phase 1.
